acceptedAnswer.text: Tillstone and The YES Group, an entitlement and development services firm, work together as one team on select projects, and between us cover all six stages.

mainEntity.name: Can I bring you in for just one stage?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Many projects start with a single stage, such as due diligence or entitlements, and add others as the work moves. Each step is scoped and priced in writing before it begins.
A project retainer plus task fees, agreed in writing before work starts.
Tillstone serves projects across the U.S. Tell us where the site is and we’ll confirm how the team would cover it.

mainEntity.name: What happens after I reach out?

acceptedAnswer.text: A partner responds directly. We talk through the parcel or the deal, which stages it needs, and how the engagement would be set up. Nothing starts until the scope and price are agreed in writing.
